source_dataset_independence: PV-896 README states no PV08 or G:/pv imagery; original GF source scenes are distinct by documented provenance.
label_definition: grayscale 0=background, 255=photovoltaic; support labels only for prototypes/calibration, query labels only for fixed post-lock scoring
selection_rule: All 6 scenes with bbox latitude >26 degrees are queries; SHA-256 first 8 sample IDs per scene. SHA-256 first 8 of 10 scenes with bbox latitude <24 degrees each provide the lowest-SHA labeled-positive support. Query assignment cycles through fixed supports. No model predictions or query mask contents used for selection.
geography_rule: Support scene envelopes are entirely below 24 N; query scene envelopes are entirely above 26 N. Bboxes are derived from CSV EPSG:4326 affine transforms.
gsd_rule: Approximate WGS84 meters per pixel at tile center computed from angular affine resolution; not a source-certified sensor GSD.
date_rule: Acquisition dates parsed from original GeoTIFF filenames in manifest; not scene submission date.
dino_geometry: Four independent 448x448 crops, 28x28 tokens each, stitched to 56x56.
checkpoint_policy: Use all 30 already validation-selected stage3 checkpoints without external selection or tuning.
prediction_threshold: Fixed logits >= 0; never selected on PV-896 query labels.
